REJECT

The patch changes `CodeHealth.Core.Classification.SourceClassifier` to the bare `SourceClassifier` in the new `IsFirstPartySource` but adds no `using CodeHealth.Core.Classification;`. The original fully qualified call suggests the file has no such using, so this likely fails to compile (CS0103/CS0246). I couldn't open the file here to confirm, so this rests on the diff alone. The extraction itself otherwise appears behaviour-preserving.
